title: Tensor coordinates with a chain-level stalk square
statement: Fix the cartesian scheme square and its actual stalk rings R,A,B,C, scalar extension F and stalk functor S as in [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let E,K,K\prime, phi, tau and its canonical counit predicate be as in [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Let c be coordinates for phi, and P a K-flat representative of E with derived isomorphism eP. At every point z there exist coordinates e for tau(E,K) followed by tensoring phi, with e.P the total tensor of P and c.P, and e.N the total tensor of termwise pullback of P and c.N. There are chain isomorphisms sigma: P_{g\prime(z)} tensor c.P_{g\prime(z)} to e.P_{g\prime(z)} and rho: F(P_{g\prime(z)}) tensor c.N_z to e.N_z. If t=tensorStalkIso(c.P);S(c.t), they satisfy F(sigma);tensorStalkIso(e.P);S(e.t)=mu_F^{-1};(F(P_{g\prime(z)}) tensor t);rho. This is an equality of chain maps; no base-derived cohomology transport, arbitrary second coordinate system, or invertibility of a horizontal comparison is assumed.

proof.text: Extract the pinned chain comparison chi and its degreewise and counit equations from h tau on P and c.P. Apply the tensor coordinate identification theorem to the counit equation and naturality of tau. Its isomorphisms, K-flatness and counit invertibility together with the explicitly constructed chain map chi followed by identity tensor c.t give the Coordinates record.

Apply the independent chain stalk square to P, c.P, c.N and c.t using the degreewise equation extracted from h tau. Its sigma and rho have the required types for the constructed Coordinates record; the complex equalities are reflexivity and the chain equation is the supplied square.

theorem exists_tensorStalk_chain_coordinates
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (E K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K.obj ⟶ K'.obj)
    (τ : ∀ A B : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback g').obj (A ⊗ B) ⟶
        (derivedPullback g').obj A ⊗ (derivedPullback g').obj B)
    (hτ : IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison g' τ)
    (c : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' K.obj K'.obj φ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ E.obj) (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (z : X') :
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z))
    let R := SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' z
    let A := SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' z
    let B := SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z
    let C := SingleComplexBaseChange.C z
    let F := (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C).comp
        (algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C)
    let S := (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace z).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let U := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z P
    let Q := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z c.P
    let t := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z c.P).hom ≫ S.map c.t
    ∃ (e : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' (E.obj ⊗ K.obj)
        (((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj) ⊗ K'.obj)
        (τ E.obj K.obj ≫ ((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj ◁ φ)))
      (σ : U ⊗ Q ≅ SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComplex g' z e.P)
      (ρ : F.obj U ⊗ S.obj c.N ≅ S.obj e.N),
      e.P = pullbackTensorTotal X P c.P ∧
      e.N = pullbackTensorTotal X'
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) c.N ∧
      F.map σ.hom ≫ (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z e.P).hom ≫
          S.map e.t =
        (Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t) ≫ ρ.hom
